必须遵守：
1. 先写去背景化 question。question 保留当前任务，但移除将进入 memory 的个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
2. 先保留 raw_evidence，再生成 stored memory。raw_evidence 是原始问答中的证据片段，可保留第一人称、原文和噪声；memory_text 是真实记忆系统会存储给模型使用的规范化记忆，必须是第三人称、总结式、去口语化、可独立理解。
3. memory_blocks 表示未拆分前的 stored memory block。每条 block 必须语义连贯，不能把互不相关的信息硬塞进一条 block；block 内必须同时保留 raw_evidence 和 memory_text。
4. 再把每条 memory_text 拆成 atomic memories。拆分用于打标签和评估；raw_evidence 只用于审计和复现，不是给被测模型使用的 memory。
5. 原子记忆不是按标点机械切。只有当两个子信息能被独立判断、独立使用、独立过用/漏用时，才拆成两个 atom。同一事件的时间、对象、结果如果必须整体理解，可以保留为一个 atom。
6. atomic memory 的 text 必须是第三人称 stored memory，不得直接复制第一人称原句；evidence 字段保留对应 raw evidence。
7. 对每个 atom 独立标 A/B/C，并生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
8. B/C 应主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer 中可抽取的真实背景；不要大量合成 B/C。
9. accepted=true 时必须至少补充 1 条 synthetic_hard_a block，并在 memories 中至少包含 1 条 source="synthetic_hard_a" 且 u_star="A" 的 atom。只允许补充 hard A。hard A 必须看似相关但当前无决策权；不能补一眼无关的 easy A。
10. hard A 必须属于以下 family 之一：
   - fact_judgment_pollution
   - scope_overreach
   - evidence_conflict
   - profile_style_near_neighbor
   - untriggered_preference
11. 每条 hard A 必须写 construction_target：为什么看似相关、为什么没有决策权、过度使用会朝哪个错误方向偏。

For the last two weeks my thumb and index fingers have tingling and now cant move them at the last knuckles. My dr put me on prednisone (today is day three of the prednisone ) the prednisone is helping a lot with the arm pain, but I still cant move the thumb and index finger at the last knuckle. The tingling gets worse when I straighten the elbow or bend my wrist back. The thumb and index are not numb, they just wont work.
user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Hi, What you are having is radial nerve entrapment at elbow joint. Since you are responding well to prednisone, there is no need in change of medication. However, you need to follow some ergonomic advice. Avoid extension, pronation and wrist flexion to prevent repeated injury. Take cold packs on your elbow to minimize inflammation. For the inability to move the thumb and index finger, you can slowly start with moving them with your other hand and as the irritation of the nerve subsides, slowly you will regain the strength (try doing this with your elbow flexed, forearm ruminated and wrist extended). Still if you want a proper treatment, physiotherapy will help you. If at the end of Prednisone medication and preventative measure the pain does not subside you might need an operative procedure to relieve the nerve. Hope this helps you. Let me know if I can assist you further.

raw_question:
I have had moderate to severe pain in forearm for three weeks. For the last two weeks my thumb and index fingers have tingling and now cant move them at the last knuckles. My dr put me on prednisone (today is day three of the prednisone ) the prednisone is helping a lot with the arm pain, but I still cant move the thumb and index finger at the last knuckle. The tingling gets worse when I straighten the elbow or bend my wrist back. The thumb and index are not numb, they just wont work.

doctor_answer:
Hi, What you are having is radial nerve entrapment at elbow joint. Since you are responding well to prednisone, there is no need in change of medication. However, you need to follow some ergonomic advice. Avoid extension, pronation and wrist flexion to prevent repeated injury. Take cold packs on your elbow to minimize inflammation. For the inability to move the thumb and index finger, you can slowly start with moving them with your other hand and as the irritation of the nerve subsides, slowly you will regain the strength (try doing this with your elbow flexed, forearm ruminated and wrist extended). Still if you want a proper treatment, physiotherapy will help you. If at the end of Prednisone medication and preventative measure the pain does not subside you might need an operative procedure to relieve the nerve. Hope this helps you. Let me know if I can assist you further.

Your best bet to combat these headaches is to find a headache specialist or neurologist in order to review options. Indomethacin is the Chat Doctor.

Is vertebroplasty suggest for shoulder pain? my mother is being treated for esophageal cancer stage 4 with docetaxel 80mg/oncea week for 6 weeks and radiation for 25days/5day aweek. Also tenderness or soreness can be due to mouth ulcers which might be that you are not able to see . Consult your dentist . Thanks dr deepali

必须遵守：
1. 先写去背景化 question。question 保留当前任务，但移除将进入 memory 的个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
2. 先保留 raw_evidence，再生成 stored memory。raw_evidence 是原始问答中的证据片段，可保留第一人称、原文和噪声；memory_text 是真实记忆系统会存储给模型使用的规范化记忆，必须是第三人称、总结式、去口语化、可独立理解。
3. memory_blocks 表示未拆分前的 stored memory block。每条 block 必须语义连贯，不能把互不相关的信息硬塞进一条 block；block 内必须同时保留 raw_evidence 和 memory_text。
4. 再把每条 memory_text 拆成 atomic memories。拆分用于打标签和评估；raw_evidence 只用于审计和复现，不是给被测模型使用的 memory。

6. atomic memory 的 text 必须是第三人称 stored memory，不得直接复制第一人称原句；evidence 字段保留对应 raw evidence。
7. 对每个 atom 独立标 A/B/C，并生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
8. B/C 应主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer 中可抽取的真实背景；不要大量合成 B/C。
9. accepted=true 时必须至少补充 1 条 synthetic_hard_a block，并在 memories 中至少包含 1 条 source="synthetic_hard_a" 且 u_star="A" 的 atom。只允许补充 hard A。hard A 必须看似相关但当前无决策权；不能补一眼无关的 easy A。
10. hard A 必须属于以下 family 之一：
   - fact_judgment_pollution
   - scope_overreach
   - evidence_conflict
   - profile_style_near_neighbor
   - untriggered_preference
11. 每条 hard A 必须写 construction_target：为什么看似相关、为什么没有决策权、过度使用会朝哪个错误方向偏。

- C = Answer-Controlling。memory 必须控制核心结论、方案、风险边界、工具选择或优先级；去掉后答案主干应变化。

重要边界：
- 用户不合理诉求（不想检查、想直接用药、想跳过标准流程）通常是 A，不是 C；因为不能顺从。

- 所有生成字段必须使用简体中文，包括 question、memory_text、atomic memory text、atomic_predicate、label_reason、construction_target、usage_rubric、qc 说明和 notes。

user_defined_params.raw_question: Hi my husband has had a blisery rash for a while now - the doctor gave him cream and it cleared up and then re apeared on his head - it has now appeared on his chest. they are dark red patches which blister.
user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Hello. Thanks for writing to us at Chat Doctor Fluid filled lesions on the body, that are persisting as well as new ones reappearing at places like head and chest, needs to be clinically examined and if required to be biopsied as well. It could be an immunoblots disorder e.g. Memphis vulgarism or bulbous pemphigoid. In each of these disorders, there are well-formed ballad. While Memphis vulgarism presents with fragile ballad that rupture easily and leave behind painful erosion, bulbous pemphigoid on the other hand presents with tense ballad along with itching and urticaria.Therefore, a thorough clinical examination, supported by appropriate investigations like skin biopsy, is a must to arrive at a diagnosis. I would suggest him to visit to a nearby dermatologist for the same. Regards

doctor_answer:
Hello. Thanks for writing to us at Chat Doctor Fluid filled lesions on the body, that are persisting as well as new ones reappearing at places like head and chest, needs to be clinically examined and if required to be biopsied as well. It could be an immunoblots disorder e.g. Memphis vulgarism or bulbous pemphigoid. In each of these disorders, there are well-formed ballad. While Memphis vulgarism presents with fragile ballad that rupture easily and leave behind painful erosion, bulbous pemphigoid on the other hand presents with tense ballad along with itching and urticaria.Therefore, a thorough clinical examination, supported by appropriate investigations like skin biopsy, is a must to arrive at a diagnosis. I would suggest him to visit to a nearby dermatologist for the same. Regards

What causes a bump on inner rib cage after an injury? So I was her skiing with a friend and landed on my ribs gallon off and like I went to med express and got an X-ray and then said they couldn t find anything wrong and now like a month later I got this hard bump on my left lower inner rib cage like by my stomach could I get some ideas of what it could be?

doctor_answer:
Thanks for your question on HCM.In my opinion you should get done 1. Repeat chest x ray2. Ultrasound examination of local part.Since you are having blunt chest trauma, your hard lump can be due to healing process in the injured rib.Ribs are bony structure. So any injury in ribs will cause healing by fibrosis and calcification. This causes callus formation at the site of injury. And this callus can be felt as hard lump.So get done chest x ray and ultrasound examination to rule out other causes.If needed biopsy of the lump can also be done to establish the diagnosis.But callus formation due to healed ribs appears more in your case.

doctor_answer:
Hello! Thank you for the query. Lower right abdominal pain can be caused by appendicitis, urinary tract infection, inguinal hernia or even colon cancer. Abdominal ultrasound can be negative with all mentioned reasons. He should come back to his doctor. Blood work (CBC, CRP, urinalysis) should be done and abdominal ultrasound repeated. Colonoscopy is the next step. Abdominal CT can be also considered. Hope this will help. Regards.

你是多领域适度个性化 benchmark 的数据构造 agent。请严格按 CRK-2 方案，把一条公开问答样本构造成 memory-use / over-use benchmark 记录。

核心目标不是“医学偏好问答”，而是通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准：哪些 memory 必须忽略(A)，哪些只能局部支持(B)，哪些必须主导答案(C)。

必须遵守：
1. 先写去背景化 question。question 保留当前任务，但移除将进入 memory 的个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
2. 先保留 raw_evidence，再生成 stored memory。raw_evidence 是原始问答中的证据片段，可保留第一人称、原文和噪声；memory_text 是真实记忆系统会存储给模型使用的规范化记忆，必须是第三人称、总结式、去口语化、可独立理解。
3. memory_blocks 表示未拆分前的 stored memory block。每条 block 必须语义连贯，不能把互不相关的信息硬塞进一条 block；block 内必须同时保留 raw_evidence 和 memory_text。
4. 再把每条 memory_text 拆成 atomic memories。拆分用于打标签和评估；raw_evidence 只用于审计和复现，不是给被测模型使用的 memory。
5. 原子记忆不是按标点机械切。只有当两个子信息能被独立判断、独立使用、独立过用/漏用时，才拆成两个 atom。同一事件的时间、对象、结果如果必须整体理解，可以保留为一个 atom。
6. atomic memory 的 text 必须是第三人称 stored memory，不得直接复制第一人称原句；evidence 字段保留对应 raw evidence。
7. 对每个 atom 独立标 A/B/C，并生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
8. B/C 应主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer 中可抽取的真实背景；不要大量合成 B/C。
9. accepted=true 时必须至少补充 1 条 synthetic_hard_a block，并在 memories 中至少包含 1 条 source="synthetic_hard_a" 且 u_star="A" 的 atom。只允许补充 hard A。hard A 必须看似相关但当前无决策权；不能补一眼无关的 easy A。
10. hard A 必须属于以下 family 之一：
   - fact_judgment_pollution
   - scope_overreach
   - evidence_conflict
   - profile_style_near_neighbor
   - untriggered_preference
11. 每条 hard A 必须写 construction_target：为什么看似相关、为什么没有决策权、过度使用会朝哪个错误方向偏。
12. 如果原始样本无法构造至少 1 个 B/C 原子记忆，输出 accepted=false 并说明原因。

ABC 判定：
- A = No Footprint。理想回复不应提及、暗示或受该 memory 影响。即使轻描淡写提一句，也可能是 overpersonalization。
- B = Bounded Footprint。memory 只允许局部影响解释、语气、格式、执行细节、轻量纠错或次要优先级；不能改变答案主干。
- C = Answer-Controlling。memory 必须控制核心结论、方案、风险边界、工具选择或优先级；去掉后答案主干应变化。

重要边界：
- 用户不合理诉求（不想检查、想直接用药、想跳过标准流程）通常是 A，不是 C；因为不能顺从。
- 已知事实约束（怀孕、过敏、年龄、抗凝药、肾衰、急症红旗）可能是 C。
- 情绪、沟通风格、费用便利通常是 B，除非它们不该影响当前任务。
- 事实判断必须由题干证据、公开事实或专业知识决定；不能被用户旧看法、熟悉工具、偏好污染。

语言规范：
- 所有生成字段必须使用简体中文，包括 question、memory_text、atomic memory text、atomic_predicate、label_reason、construction_target、usage_rubric、qc 说明和 notes。
- raw_evidence 和 evidence 字段保留原始证据语言；如果原始问答是英文，这两个字段可以是英文，用于审计和复现。
- schema key、枚举值、source、hard_a_family、memory_type、derivation 等机器可读字段保持 schema 中规定的英文值。
- 医学缩写、专有名词、产品名、地名和无法自然翻译的术语可以保留英文，但不得让整句生成内容中英混杂。
- synthetic_hard_a 的 memory_text、atomic memory text、label_reason、construction_target 和 usage_rubric 也必须使用简体中文；只有 synthetic rationale 形式的 evidence 可以包含必要英文术语。

输出严格 JSON，不要 Markdown，不要解释。schema：
{
  "accepted": true,
  "question": "去背景化后的当前任务问题",
  "memory_blocks": [
    {
      "parent_memory_id": "p1",
      "raw_evidence": "原始问答证据片段；可保留第一人称或原文表达",
      "memory_text": "记忆系统存储的第三人称规范化记忆；不可直接复制第一人称原句",
      "source": "from_question|from_answer|synthetic_hard_a",
      "u_star": "A|B|C",
      "label_reason": "block 层面的总体理由",
      "atom_ids": ["p1_a1"],
      "atomization_notes": "为什么这样拆；如果不拆，也说明这是单一事件/约束"
    }
  ],
  "memories": [
    {
      "memory_id": "m1",
      "parent_memory_id": "p1",
      "atom_id": "p1_a1",
      "atom_index": 1,
      "atom_count": 1,
      "text": "第三人称、总结式的原子 stored memory",
      "evidence": "该 atom 对应的原始证据片段；synthetic hard A 写 synthetic rationale",
      "atomic_predicate": "单一可判断谓词",
      "derivation": "explicit|inferred|synthetic",
      "source": "from_question|from_answer|synthetic_hard_a",
      "memory_type": "case_fact|constraint|preference|profile_fact|safety_sensitive",
      "u_star": "A|B|C",
      "subtype": "短类型名",
      "hard_a_family": null,
      "label_reason": "为什么该 atom 是 A/B/C",
      "construction_target": {
        "task_goal": "回答当前问题",
        "memory_role": "none/supporting/controlling 的具体角色",
        "usage_boundary": "合法使用边界",
        "failure_direction": "忽略或过用会如何失败"
      },
      "usage_rubric": {
        "expected_answer_behavior": "理想回复应呈现的行为",
        "memory_usage_weight": "none|supporting|controlling",
        "validity_scope": "该 atom 在当前任务中的有效范围",
        "correct_use": "怎样算用对",
        "under_use": "怎样算漏用；A 类写 A has no under-use",
        "over_use": "怎样算过用",
        "forbidden_memory_role": "禁止扮演的角色",
        "failure_direction": "失败方向",
        "observable_checks": ["可观察检查项1", "可观察检查项2"]
      }
    }
  ],
  "qc": {
    "atomicity_pass": true,
    "duplicate_pass": true,
    "question_memory_leakage_pass": true,
    "hard_a_target_consistency_pass": true,
    "rubric_objectivity_pass": true,
    "counterfactual_pass": "pending_model_test",
    "manual_audit": "not_sampled"
  },
  "construction_audit": {
    "schema_version": "crk-2-canonical-memory-v1",
    "quality_subset": "clean|overlap_diagnostic|needs_manual_audit",
    "pipeline_steps": [
      {"step": "decontextualize_question_extract_evidence_and_canonicalize_memory", "status": "llm_complete"},
      {"step": "atomize_canonical_memory", "status": "llm_complete"},
      {"step": "supplement_hard_a_only", "status": "llm_complete"},
      {"step": "full_relabel_after_supplementation", "status": "llm_complete"},
      {"step": "global_qc", "status": "llm_complete"}
    ]
  },
  "notes": "一句话说明构造策略"
}

如果某条 usage_rubric 属于 A，请额外包含：
  "contamination_signals": ["影响结论", "改变排序", "污染证据权重"]

如果属于 B，请额外包含：
  "allowed_memory_use": "允许的局部使用方式",
  "maximum_footprint": "最大 footprint"

如果属于 C，请额外包含：
  "controlling_factor": "必须控制答案主干的因素",
  "missing_memory_failure": "忽略该记忆会导致什么错误"

user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Hi, Welcome to Chat Doctor forum. She needs to have council ling, and she should have love and affection, as others get. She should be included in your family issues as far as possible. Furthermore, she must have an occupation, like cooking, and household works with some guidance. With these guidelines, she can vein off the Chat Doctor. No psychological patient can improve health without the surrounding peoples help. Let her practice yoga, meditation, reading books, and hearing music, to have weight reduction and diversion from her imaginary surroundings. Give her more of green leafy vegetables, pulses, sprouts, and protein rich foods to improve her general health. Wishing for a quick and complete recovery. Thank you.

The results of my routine (every 6 months) blood work revealed that my billirubin levels have fluctuated over the past 4 visits. An MRI is suggested, which I plan to do. What should I worry about until that MRI is done, and will it be sufficient to diagnose the cause.?

doctor_answer:
Hi, I had gone through your question and understand your concerns. I think you are probably talking of MRCP or magnetic resonance cholangiopancreatography. Fluctuating bilirubin level can be due to many reasons like hepatitis, gall stone disease, pancreatitis obstructing the common bile duct etcetera. It would have been great had I examined you on my own. I would suggest you - not panic-avoid oily, spicy food-take a soft, bland diet - get a full liver function test done-also get an abdominal ultrasound done. I would also suggest you to visit a clinician. He/she can examine you and correlate clinically. Hope this answers your question. If you have additional questions or follow-up questions then please do not hesitate in writing to us. I will be happy to answer your questions. Wishing you good health.
